role: Declares the container-screen layout struct and the three geometry functions of gui_screens.c the play client and HUD renderer use for drawing and mouse hit testing. Also gui_screen_effects_shift and gui_screen_key_click.

structs.name: gui_screen_layout
structs.java: ScaledResolution's scaled width/height and scale factor plus GuiContainer's guiLeft, guiTop, xSize, ySize

notes: Included by gui_screens.c, raster_hud.c and play/play.c.
